# Personal Numerology

A Skill Harbor house build, third skill in the Sky and Wellbeing family, and the most checkable of the three. Personal Numerology makes one promise and keeps it literally: every number it gives you is computed with a public formula, written out in full in the skill, and shown to you step by step, intermediate sums included. Life path, expression number if you want it, personal year, personal month, personal day: pick any result, redo the arithmetic by hand, and you land on the same number. One main method is used everywhere (month, day and year reduced separately, then added), and when a known variant would give a different answer on your date, the skill says so and shows the difference instead of hiding it.

What the numbers mean is another matter, and the skill keeps the two separate. The meanings come from the numerological tradition and are labelled as tradition every time: no prediction is presented as fact, no cycle number justifies a decision, and master numbers 11, 22 and 33 are handled by one stated rule, applied the same way everywhere. Around the calculations sits the family journal: short local entries tagged with the cycle numbers of their date, and at the end of each personal year a review where you give the verdict, resonated, did not resonate, or in between, counted later from your own journal with the denominator visible. Your birth data never leaves your device. Free to use under the Skill Harbor House License v1.0: install it, use it for yourself, don't...
